entries.reason: Supersedes the brand-v2-shell-home credit-line delta for this member, which is folded in here because a member carries one delta: the registered credit for the covariate-shift diagram still reads Robot Wiki (original diagram) rather than the v1 lowercase name. On top of that, the registry record now carries figureKind original-schematic, the legal basis owned, its derived attribution sentence, and the preservation policy first-party-restyled-semantics-preserved, and the shipped SVG bytes were repainted from the v1 amber-on-slate palette to the brand-v2 ink, graphite, concrete, and lime foundation. Only fill, stroke, stroke-width, and opacity values changed: the normalized semantic hash under the VAL-B2-VIZ-014 allowlist is byte-identical before and after, so every path, coordinate, dash pattern, font-family, font-size, label string, and the role/aria-label textual alternative are the same drawing.
entries.ownerApproval: contract/design-integrity.md VAL-B2-IMG-002 requires the §1.13 legal basis, attribution text, and preservation policy to live in canonical metadata; VAL-B2-VIZ-014 admits restyling of a first-party SVG whose normalized semantic geometry and label text are unchanged.
